DoseCerta helps organize reminders and records. It does not replace medical advice, prescribe treatments, or provide emergency services. Do not change a dose on your own.

Names, doses, schedules, and records are stored in this app on this device. There is no account registration or automatic upload of this data. Protection also depends on the device’s lock and security.
You can archive medications while keeping history, permanently delete a medication while keeping history, or delete both the medication and its records. Exported PDFs are copies outside the app: deleting local data does not remove copies already saved or shared.
Sensitive details are hidden on the lock screen by default. Review your privacy choice in Settings. Notification and alarm access enable reminders; denying access limits delivery. Android and device manufacturers may restrict alerts.
